## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track S (safety, trust and handoff behaviour), wave S3. This is audit backlog UX-33 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: mobile/clinician and mobile/patient in Expo Go on a simulator.
Findings and reviewers: F-34 · reviewers C-20, C-21, B-25.
Rationale: pnpm dev:clinician then opening in Expo Go fails with Cannot find module @babel/helper-define-polyfill-provider, so nobody can run or review the mobile apps. From code only: native button borders at 1.25:1 and placeholders at 3.05:1, and web and native use different icons for the same status.
Proposed UX behaviour: Part 1: make the Babel helper resolvable in the workspace (dependency resolution only, pinned through the lockfile) so both apps bundle and open. Part 2: run the audit's method on a simulator for both apps and write the findings as tickets. Part 3, small and known: control borders use the input colour and placeholders ink600 in packages/ui-native so they meet 3:1 and 4.5:1; one icon mapping per status shared by web and native is recorded as a finding if not fixed here.
Prototype and blueprint reference: None.
Components and tokens affected: packages/ui-native controls; workspace dependency resolution.
Front end and back end split: Dependency and native front end.
Prerequisites and blocked by: None. Not in the pilot flow: the pilot runs on the web app.
Clinical sign-off: Not required.
Effort and regression risk: S · Low. A dependency change needs the reason in the pull request and pnpm audit clean.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Porting the web consolidation to ui-native. (2) Real data in the apps (MDV-P5-033). (3) Store builds.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a clean checkout, when pnpm dev:clinician and the patient app are opened in Expo Go on a simulator, then each bundles and shows its first screen
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the running apps, when the audit is done, then its findings are tickets with evidence and synthetic data only
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a secondary button and a placeholder in ui-native, when contrast is computed, then the border is at least 3:1 and the placeholder at least 4.5:1
- [ ] **AC4.** Given the change, when pnpm audit runs, then it reports no high or critical issue and the lockfile pins the helper
- [ ] **AC5.** Given the mobile workspace, when CI runs, then a bundle step fails if the apps stop bundling

## Test notes

- CI bundle check for both apps.
- No Playwright scenario (native).

- Regression risk: low.
